tax_rates._note: combined destination sales-tax rates. Thornton = CO 2.9 + city 3.75 + Adams 0.75 + RTD/CD 1.1

_retail_mode_note: uniform = Eagle's Nest standard: financed = check/ACH / 0.93 on the whole price. gc_at_cost = Jason Ct R5 method (GC excluded from the 7%).
_tax_note: standing rule (Eagle's Nest): sales tax 4% on factored materials. tax_mode 'destination' uses the city table instead.
_dealer_fee_note: GSX rule: 12.5% dealer fee is added manually to financed quotes; the 7% check/ACH spread does not cover it — owner to confirm whether the retail line absorbs it (open, 7 Sep 2026)
